product_metadata.title: Etekcity Digital Kitchen Timer, Big Digits Loud Alarm Magnetic Backing Stand with Large LCD Display for Cooking Baking Sports Games Office (2 Pack, White, Battery Included)
features: LARGE READOUT: Large 2.56 x 1.32 in. bold digits for easy readability from anywhere in the kitchen.
CUSTOM ACCESS: Includes magnetic backing, foldout stand, and hanging hook for display versatility.
LOUD ALARM SYSTEM: Features loud and clear but not deafening sound to be heard from another room
PORTABLE & COMPACT: Easy to store and take on the go with simple lightweight for cooking.
EASY USE: Simple operation with countdown and count up functions with max time: 99 min., 59 sec.
